goal:
PoE1 3.30 Covens of Umbra, softcore trade. Make multiple mirrors through farming, crafting and investing.
3.30 changes that matter for the build: you invoke Fates on area bosses (campaign and maps) to make them harder for better loot and Viscera, Mirage is core and can cover a whole map, scarabs are gone (Threads of Creation + Atlas regions instead), and balance changes are expected to be mild.
So: a starter that clears fast AND kills Fate-empowered bosses safely, cheap on day 1, scaling to mirror-tier gear.

builds.name: Toxic Rain Pathfinder
builds.notes: Called 'The Fastest League Start Build in Allflame League'. Very forgiving on day 1, flasks keep it safe.
builds.patch: Safest campaign. Fine with Fates. Lower ceiling than Winter Orb.

builds.name: Lightning Arrow Deadeye
builds.notes: Fubgun's go-to league starter. Fastest clear for farming strategies; weak bosser until geared. Mirror-tier gear makes it absurd.
builds.patch: Best pure clear, which matters more now that Mirage can cover a whole map. Weakest at Fate-empowered bosses until geared, so invoke fewer Fates early. Good second character.

builds.name: Winter Orb Elementalist
builds.notes: Fubgun's Allflame starter (most viewed guide). Winter Orb Occultist and Elementalist were the #2 and #3 builds on poe.ninja at league end.
builds.patch: PICK for 3.30. Allflame's #2 and #3 most played builds were Winter Orb (Occultist 4.5%, Elementalist 2.8%), it was buffed in 3.29 and balance is meant to be mild. Kills Fate bosses safely and clears well. People are already posting 3.30 Winter Orb starter PoBs.

builds.name: Kinetic Blast of Clustering Necromancer
builds.notes: Fast wand clear. Its 21/20 gem sold for 387c on day 3 last league, so its gems are worth levelling if it is popular again.
builds.patch: Fast clear, weak bossing; Fate bosses make it riskier in week 1.

builds.name: Cold Dot Occultist
builds.notes: bLut reported up to 18M DPS by day 3. Best bosser of the starters; slower mapper. Check the main skill in his guide (set to Vortex here).
builds.patch: Best bosser for stacking Fates and Grim Fates later. Slower mapper. Good pivot if Fates turn out to be the main money.

builds.name: Righteous Fire Chieftain
builds.notes: Most played build in Allflame at league end (4.6%). Very tanky for heavily juiced maps; needs life and regen gear first.
builds.patch: Tanky for Fates and harder Threads stacks, but slow clear and needs life gear first.

builds.name: Shockwave Cyclone Slayer
builds.notes: Melee map blaster. Cyclone of Tumult and Void Shockwave Slayers were both top 10 at league end.
builds.patch: Melee option. New Sword of Ages unique (Temporal Mirage on movement attacks) may add melee options; wait for patch notes.

builds.name: Animate Guardian Luminary
builds.notes: Top 4 in Allflame. Luminary was introduced with Allflame; check if it stays in 3.30.
builds.patch: Luminary came with Allflame; likely not available in 3.30 unless patch notes say otherwise.
